protocol.purpose: Research hindcasts and controlled candidate comparison; no strategy optimization or live authority
protocol.primary_score: standardized marginal ensemble CRPS, averaged over variables and months
protocol.new_selection_windows: Only evaluation intervals explicitly disjoint from previously consumed batches; chronological eras overlap elsewhere only for diagnostic reporting
protocol.reconstruction: Existing 2020-2025 ETF gate is already inspected and remains frozen diagnostic; never called untouched
protocol.macro_availability: Release/vintage rows must be <= forecast origin. Current revised history may be used only with an explicit pseudo-real-time research label and promotion block
protocol.daily_bridge: Monthly predictions do not identify daily observations. Any future daily bridge is a separately seeded hypothetical conditional path model

registry_decision.authority: Research model only; never trading strategy/live deployment

scope: Retrospective chronological out-of-sample research; equity data revisions prevent real-time certification
limitations: Forecasts are immutable before scoring, but historical outcomes are known to human researchers
All declared eras are diagnostics; only complete disjoint eras enter selection
Early missing macro vintages and current revised equity history block verified promotion
Synthetic future Student-t log returns have no finite expected arithmetic wealth; use quantiles, not a mean wealth forecast
